lore: Every save the islands write sails to the archive harbour, where one old crane lands them on the quay at its own steady pace. On calm days the boats trickle in; when a storm swell hits, a whole fleet arrives at once. Behind the breakwater the boats wait their turn. Build it too short and the swell smashes boats against the rocks; build it too long and the line of waiting boats stretches out to sea, and a save might wait half a season to land.

lines.start: Six boats a tick, that's all my crane can land. The breakwater holds the rest until I'm ready.
lines.swell: Swell coming in! Forty boats at once. Hope there's room behind the wall.
lines.crane: Steady now. One, two, three... six. Next.
lines.win: Hardly a boat lost all season and nobody waited long for the crane.
lines.fail: Either the swell smashed half the fleet or the line stretches to the horizon. Rebuild that wall.
